//: Story Phase 15 world scripts: inspections of what the Great Mellowing leaves behind, and the sash pad.
p15.inspect.mk2_gutted: The Mark II. Dark. No valve, no wire, no horseshoe. For the first time in its life, it looks like an ordinary broken television.
p15.inspect.mk2_parts: A valve, a wire, and Ned's lucky horseshoe, on the floor where you threw them.

then: The Mark II is on again, a yard away, running perfectly well without any of them. Nobody has picked them up. There doesn't seem to be much point.

p15.inspect.tv_protocol: THE BROGATH TELEVISION SAFETY PROTOCOL, in Pete's capitals. ONE: when he blushes, compliment him. TWO: commercial break, blanket ready. THREE: a sash on screen, cover his eyes. FOUR: a sash in the room, secure it. FIVE: Squawks, NO FLAP. SIX: Garrick, NO BEANS.

then: Underneath, newer: SEVEN: IF EVERYBODY IS MELLOW, THE CAPTAIN DOES IT ALL.

p15.inspect.blanket: The anti-commercial blanket, folded, on the floor by the set. Ready. Gristle checks it's there every time he walks past. So do you, now.
p15.inspect.crate_gone: Where the Grand Currency crate stood: a square of cleaner floorboard, and three tokens nobody bothered with. NOT LEGAL TENDER.
p15.inspect.stores: The stores. Half restocked. Garrick's committee has been 'looking into it'. There is a spoon on the shelf with teeth marks in it.

then: The Skunk Weed, in crates: STEMS (many), SEEDS, LEAF (five, in straw), DUST, and the one with the lid nailed on. ESPECIALLY SKUNKY. {num:skunk_weed_lots} lots, on Pete's manifest.
A padlock on the lid now, and Pete's sign: EMERGENCY MELLOWING SUPPLY. CAPTAIN'S AUTHORITY ONLY. GROWN-UPS ONLY.

else: The mountain. Mostly stems. It smells like a skunk that has been up all night, and, underneath, faintly, Brogath.

p15.inspect.boat: SECOND THOUGHTS. The visitors' little boat, where the Sharkstorm put it. The engine is never going anywhere again. The cool box is full of crackers now; Jim's idea of rationing.
p15.inspect.safe_corner: SAFE CORNER. NO FLAME WITHIN FORTY FEET OF ANYTHING GRAND. THIS MEANS THE CARDBOARD ONE. AND THE TREASURE ROOM. AND GARRICK. Sand, water, a rope, two folding chairs. Gristle measured it twice.
p15.inspect.rail_storm: The Sharkstorm, going round. Somewhere in it, two pillows, still growling at each other. On one of them, if you look long enough, a small brown shape. Sitting perfectly still. Looking about her.
captain: (quietly) Not today. Not into THAT. But not never.

then: THE BASHFULNESS BRANCH. The sign says CLOSING. The queue doesn't believe it.
else: THE BASHFULNESS BRANCH. OPEN SO LONG AS BROGATH REMAINS BASHFUL. A tiny bell. A brass window. A teller made of haze who has been on shift for forty years.

p15.inspect.branch_marks: Where the Bashfulness Branch was: six little scorch marks and a dent in the floorboards. It smells, very faintly, of coins. It's closed. For good. The bell, mercifully, went with it.
p15.inspect.perch: Agnes the Second's perch: a little crate with a sash folded in it, HOLD MY SASH!, and a brown feather or two.

then: Empty. Brogath sits by it in the evenings. He says he isn't waiting. He's waiting.

p15.inspect.old_pillow: The last of the old pillows. Yellowish. Greyish. It has a fold in the middle like a mouth, and it is breathing, and it is GROWLING at you.
p15.inspect.no_beard: A sign on the zone's wall, in your capitals: NO BEARD JOINTS. A drawing of a beard, crossed out. Garrick has written underneath, very small: 'or merchandise?'. Somebody has crossed that out too.

then: The loose floorboard. Under it, the little iron box. In the box: stems. You keep them. You're not sure why. Proof, maybe. Of what, you couldn't say.
else: The loose floorboard. Under it, seven real doubloons, in a little iron box. You stand on it.

p15.zone_pad: Your sash pad: HOLD MY SASH!, folded four deep, and a GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND NAP for a blanket. Fart-themed. Not fart-scented. They were right. You'll never tell them.

then: You lie down for a while. Nobody deposits anything.

vindicta.idle: vindicta: (forming, indignant) I am GRAND STENCHMISTRESS VINDICTA THUNDERWAFT THE...
She dissolves before she can finish. She seems to find that the most insulting thing of all.
